newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gold seen rising on export prospects.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gold seen rising on export prospects.

text.p: Pakistan gold prices are likely to rise this week on hopes that gold jewellery exports will rise after the central bank eased restrictions, dealers said on Monday.

The central bank announced last week that indigenous precious and semi-precious stones and gold jewellery could now be exported without its approval. Exporters would need only certification from an authorised foreign exchange dealer as evidence of the realisation of export proceeds, he added.
Dealers said silver prices were likely to remain steady due to low demand.
